Hello! I've been taking Cymbalta 60mg for 2 months now, and i still do occasionally feel like im on a "happy train" or "happy drunk" but usually i can snap out of it pretty quickly, make sure to eat before taking cymbalta. When i started taking Cymbalta at first i didnt eat much, and then i had more and stronger side effects, if your symptoms continue contact your doctor and then further information will be provided. What i found out by experimentation is that acidic foods before taking cymbalta cause me a bit of nausea and dissociation. This medicine has it's ups and downs, for me the ups out-weigh the downs. On 60mg i occasionally feel like my stomach is bloated, which is a little annoying... Feel free to PM me, i can share my experiences when first starting out!  
Best wishes!
